_about: Parameters used only by the simulation chain (muraves/simulation/). Loaded on top of ../shared/reco_parameters.json by get_reco_config(chain="simulation"); may not redefine its sections. Keys starting with '_' are documentation.

digitization._note: pe_per_cm_file: the per-run NPE/cm calibration used by the path-length digitizer when --pe-per-cm-file is given without a path. Relative to this folder.
